en: In Psalm 3, what of David's does the Lord lift up?
In Psalm 3, what does David call the Lord besides his shield?
In Psalm 3, what does David do, then wake, sustained by the Lord?
In Psalm 4, God's gift of joy exceeds abundant wine and what?
In Psalm 8, whose mouths does God use against his foes?
In Psalm 9, what of the nations is caught in their own snare?
In Psalm 10, what of the wicked does the psalmist ask God to break?
In Psalm 10, what part of the wicked is full of cursing?
In Psalm 10, under which body part of the wicked lies mischief?
In Psalm 11, the psalmist is told to flee like what to the mountains?
In Psalm 11, what does God rain on the wicked along with fire?
In Psalm 12, how many times is the silver like God's words purified?
How many times does the psalmist ask "How long?" in Psalm 13?
In Psalm 14, with which company of people is God present?
In Psalm 15, whom does the one dwelling with the Lord never defame?
In Psalm 17, the psalmist asks to be guarded like the pupil of what?
In Psalm 17, to whom do the wicked leave their abundance?
According to Psalm 18's title, from whose hand did God rescue David?
